name: Focal Activity-Graded CL (FAGCL)
tagline: Focal-weighted contrastive with activity-aware reweighting and pairwise activity-margin ranking, fused at inference with weighted pocket/protein scores.

key_hyperparams.name: γ
key_hyperparams.role: focal weighting exponent on hard positives

key_hyperparams.name: rank_margin_scale (β)
key_hyperparams.role: pairwise margin per unit activity gap

key_hyperparams.name: score_poc_weight
key_hyperparams.role: pocket vs protein fusion weight at inference

init_recovers: Vanilla CLIP when γ=0, scales=0, λ_r=0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces HCC's uniform NLL + log-rank weighting with focal-weighted (1-p)^γ NLL plus a multiplicative activity-linear weight, swaps the log-margin ranking term for a hinge on pairwise (s_j-s_k) with margin proportional to (a_j-a_k), and at inference uses a fixed convex pocket+protein fusion instead of summed scores.

name: Tri-View HCC + GELU/LN Heads
tagline: Adds LayerNorm+GELU projection heads, a positive-margin penalty, and a third 'joint' similarity view averaging pocket and protein logits.
init_recovers: HCC when m=0 and joint view is dropped
diff_from_baseline: Vs HCC: replaces the ReLU NonLinearHead with a LayerNorm+GELU MLP, subtracts a constant margin m from positive-pair logits before softmax, and computes the full HCC loss on a third 'joint' similarity matrix that averages pocket-mol and protein-mol similarities.

name: Activity-Calibrated Tri-View (ACTS)
tagline: Soft activity-weighted multi-positive contrastive over pocket, protein, and a learnable mix view, plus pairwise rank softplus, KL view-consistency, and pocket-protein alignment.

key_hyperparams.name: β (rank_margin_scale)
key_hyperparams.role: softplus rank margin per activity unit

key_hyperparams.name: mix_logit
key_hyperparams.role: sigmoid gate for poc/prot fusion view

init_recovers: Reduces toward CLIP-style symmetric contrastive when τ_s is large and λ_r=λ_c=λ_a=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs HCC: hard positive mass is replaced by softmax-over-activities multi-positive targets per pocket, a learnable sigmoid 'mix' view fuses pocket and protein logits in a third pathway, and HCC's log-margin ranking is replaced by a softplus-hinge on pairwise score gaps with margin β·Δa, augmented by symmetric KL view-consistency and a mean cosine pocket-protein alignment term.

name: Activity-Enhanced HCC (AE-HCC)
tagline: HCC variant that runs the rank loss across all L positions and downweights it by λ_rank.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_rank
key_hyperparams.role: weight on within-pocket activity ranking term

init_recovers: HCC at λ_rank=1 and rank loop on first L-1 positions only
diff_from_baseline: Vs HCC: keeps the same activity-filtered symmetric contrastive but iterates the within-pocket ranking term over all L_i positions (rather than L_i-1) and multiplies it by an explicit λ_rank=0.1 gate.

name: Activity-Reweighted CLIP
tagline: Vanilla CLIP loss with a learnable sigmoid-gated multiplicative reweighting that boosts higher-activity ligands.
formula: $$w_k = 1 + \sigma(\alpha)\cdot\frac{a_k - \min a}{\max a - \min a},\qquad \mathcal{L} = \sum_i \frac{1}{\sqrt{L_i}}\Big(\sum_{k\in i} w_k \cdot \mathrm{NLL}(p^{p\to l}_{i,k}) + \sum_{k\in i} -w_k \log p^{l\to p}_{i,k}\Big)$$
diff_from_baseline: Vs vanilla CLIP: the per-sample symmetric NLL is multiplied by a learnable activity weight w_k = 1+σ(α)·â_k computed from min-max-normalized pIC50 across the batch; no ranking, hyperbolic, or HCC components are introduced.
